# rdryad

[![Project Status: Inactive – The project has reached a stable, usable
state but is no longer being actively developed; support/maintenance
will be provided as time
allows.](https://www.repostatus.org/badges/latest/inactive.svg)](https://www.repostatus.org/#inactive)\*
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/ropensci/rdryad/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ropensci/rdryad/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)

version](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/rdryad)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=rdryad)

`rdryad` is a package to interface with the Dryad data repository.

\_\*This package will be superceded by
[{deposits}](https://github.com/ropenscilabs/deposits). See Issue
[\#39](https://github.com/ropensci/rdryad/issues/39%5D)\_

General Dryad API documentation: <https://datadryad.org/api/v2/docs/>

rdryad docs: <https://docs.ropensci.org/rdryad/>

## Installation

Install Dryad from CRAN

``` r

install.packages("rdryad")
```

development version:

``` r

remotes::install_github("ropensci/rdryad")
```

``` r

library('rdryad')
```

### Data provided by…

Data is provided from the Dryad API.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`dryad_dataset()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rdryad/reference/dryad_dataset.md)
  : Get datasets by DOI(s)

- [`dryad_dataset_versions()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rdryad/reference/dryad_dataset_versions.md)
  : Get dataset versions by DOI(s)

- [`dryad_datasets()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rdryad/reference/dryad_datasets.md)
  : List datasets

- [`dryad_download()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rdryad/reference/dryad_download.md)
  : dryad_download

- [`dryad_files()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rdryad/reference/dryad_files.md)
  : Get metadata information about a file

- [`dryad_files_download()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rdryad/reference/dryad_files_download.md)
  : Download a specific file

- [`dryad_get_cache()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rdryad/reference/dryad_get_cache.md)
  :

  Get 'rdryad' cache data as a hoardr object

- [`dryad_set_cache()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rdryad/reference/dryad_set_cache.md)
  :

  Set the 'rdryad' cache by passing a hoardr object defining cache data
  including local path.

- [`rdryad-package`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rdryad/reference/rdryad-package.md)
  [`rdryad`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rdryad/reference/rdryad-package.md)
  : Interface to the Dryad Web services

- [`dryad_versions()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rdryad/reference/versions.md)
  [`dryad_versions_files()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rdryad/reference/versions.md)
  [`dryad_versions_download()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rdryad/reference/versions.md)
  : Get a dataset version by version ID
